name: use-history-state
title: useHistoryState
description: Internal state structure for the history reducer.

tags.template: - The type of the state being managed.

parameters.name: initialPresent
parameters.description: - The initial value to populate the state history.

returnType.name: HistoryState<T>
returnType.description: An object containing the current state, control functions, and status booleans.

properties.name: state
properties.description: The current value of the state.

properties.name: set
properties.description: Function to update the current state and push the previous state to history.

properties.name: undo
properties.description: Reverts the state to the previous value in history.

properties.name: redo
properties.description: Advances the state to the next value in the redo stack.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Resets the state to the initial value and clears all history.

properties.name: canUndo
properties.description: Boolean indicating if there is history available to undo.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: Boolean indicating if there are values available to redo.
